newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cafe fire starts brief scare at HK handover venue.
newsitem.headline: Cafe fire starts brief scare at HK handover venue.

text.p: Fire in a restaurant kitchen triggered a brief scare on Monday at the gleaming new Hong Kong Convention Centre where Britain will hand the territory back to China in a midnight ceremony.

The blaze, away from the handover site, dismayed organisers of the event but it was quickly extingished after sending smoke wafting through the sprawling HK$4.8 billion (US620 million) complex built on a man-made island in Victoria Harbour.
Hundreds of VIPs will attend a banquet of Italian delicacies and champagne before the handover.
The fire on the 6th floor of the heavily-guarded seven-storey centre sent scores of journalists racing to the scene from their top-floor offices.
A fire department spokesman told Reuters the blaze, which he described as small, never threatened to spread outside the kitchen area. "The smoke made it seem worse than it was," he said.
"We have not yet determined what caused the blaze but it certainly seems accidental."
